System program error codes, nonce account constants, and execution and transaction-age APIs.

# Purpose
This header declares the interface for the Solana system program used by the Flamenco runtime. It defines system program error codes, nonce account constants, and the nonce account data length, and it also declares the main entry point [`fd_system_program_execute`](<#fd_system_program_execute>) plus the instruction handlers for account creation, transfer, allocation, assignment, and nonce account operations. The file also exposes two user APIs: [`fd_check_transaction_age`](<#fd_check_transaction_age>), which validates transaction age, and [`fd_get_system_account_kind`](<#fd_get_system_account_kind>), which classifies an account as a normal system account, a nonce account, or an unknown account kind.
